name: Mulligatawny Lentil Soup
ingredients: ½ cup (100 g) red lentils, rinsed
Lemon juice, salt and black pepper
steps: Heat the oil and cook the onion for 5 minutes. Add garlic, curry powder and turmeric and stir for 30 seconds.
Add carrot, apple, lentils and stock. Bring to a boil and simmer for 20 minutes until everything is soft.
Blend about half the soup for a partly creamy, partly chunky texture.
Stir in the coconut milk and heat through. Finish with lemon juice, salt and pepper.
note: A lightened version of the Anglo-Indian classic, built on lentils and spice instead of cream.
